description: This file defines a utility enum 'VoiceWakePreferences' for managing voice wake-up trigger words, including default values, encoding/decoding, sanitization, persistence, and display functionalities.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: String)
methods.description: Decodes JSON string payload into an array of trigger words.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: Data)
methods.description: Decodes Data object containing JSON into trigger words, ensuring proper decoding and sanitization.

methods.name: loadTriggerWords(defaults: UserDefaults)
methods.description: Loads trigger words from UserDefaults or returns default trigger words.

methods.name: saveTriggerWords(_: [String], defaults: UserDefaults)
methods.description: Saves the provided list of trigger words to UserDefaults.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWords(_: [String])
methods.description: Cleans up trigger words by trimming, filtering empty strings, limiting count and length, and providing defaults if resulting list is empty.

methods.name: displayString(for: [String])
methods.description: Formats and joins trigger words into a display string after sanitization.
